dhcp.description: Enable DHCP for interfaces that don’t specify their own mode.

ip.description: Static IPv4 address for fallback configuration (e.g., 192.168.1.10).

gateway.description: IPv4 default gateway for fallback configuration.

netmask.description: IPv4 netmask or CIDR prefix length (e.g., 255.255.255.0 or 24).

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to configure.

address.description: Static IPv4 address for this interface (overrides global 'ip').

gateway.description: IPv4 gateway for this interface (overrides global 'gateway').

netmask.description: IPv4 netmask or CIDR prefix (overrides global 'netmask').

dhcp.description: 'true' to use DHCP, 'false' for static, 'auto' to inherit global 'dhcp'.

dns.description: DNS server(s) for this interface (overrides global 'dns').

hostname.description: Hostname to set on this interface's activation (overrides global 'hostname').
